brief:
ArabLit has launched "Gaza in Books," a campaign timed to #ReadPaletineWeek, inviting readers to engage with literary works focused on Gaza. The initiative encourages participation from publishers, readers, and literary communities during the designated week of focused reading on Palestinian topics.

Participants can find full details and ways to get involved through the Publishers for Palestine website, which coordinates the broader reading campaign and related advocacy efforts around Palestinian literature.
dek: For more on how you can participate in #ReadPalestineWeek, visit the Publishers for Palestine website at publishersforpalestine.org.
title: ArabLit launches Gaza reading initiative during Palestine Week
